questions.text: Is an awaitingOutcome count with no lower bound acceptable as a performance risk, as the Upcoming count already is, or should implement add a status-aware index?

rubric_items.reason: All nine design components (CO-1 to CO-9) have at least one threat. EP-1 and EP-2 are covered through their components.
Most threats fit their component: injection, client-supplied instant, data shape, unbounded scan. T-9 and T-13 are generic or in the wrong STRIDE category.
Most mitigations cite code that checks out. T-2 and T-8 cite controls (starts_at index, paging) that do not limit the unbounded count scans they target.
T-14 states the gap that reads are not audited. T-5 calls the grant-all MVP identity an existing control instead of stating it as an accepted risk.
Short and readable. Threats are ordered by component, not by risk. The Known section mislabels which threats need new controls.
